# Beauty Atelier IN

> Beauty salon in Silistra, Bulgaria (ул. Отец Паисий 27, 7500 Силистра). Permanent makeup (PhiBrows microblading), anti-age procedures, aftercare treatments. Rated 5.0 from 34 reviews. Run by Iliyana Ilieva, PhiAcademy-certified artist.
